Definition: from G4176; a community, i.e. (abstractly) citizenship (figuratively):--conversation.
BiblicalUsage: Politeuma appears only once, and Paul makes it count: our citizenship is in heaven. The word covers the whole commonwealth we belong to, not just a passport but a shared life under one rule.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this one verse reorders everything, because if heaven is home, then earth is only where I am staying for now.
